headline: COPPER SQUEEZE WORST SINCE 2021: London Cash-to-3M Spread Hits $434/Tonne — LME Stocks Drain to 214K Tonnes, August Contract $370 Over September
snippet: The London copper squeeze intensified dramatically on August 14, with the cash-to-three-month spread widening to $434 per tonne — the widest since the 2021 squeeze that prompted LME emergency intervention — as the August contract traded at a $370/t premium over September futures and LME warehouse stocks drained to 214,550 tonnes, down 14% from July 31. The escalation from $207/t (reported earlier Friday) to $434/t in a single session marks the point at which financing-driven inventory arbitrage collapses and forced deliveries typically begin — and the thinning available inventory at 214K tonnes, against backdrop of continued AI data centre and electrification demand, means there is no visible mechanism for the squeeze to resolve without either a sharp price spike or emergency exchange intervention of the kind last seen in the 2021 nickel crisis.

headline: RARE EARTHS EXPLODE: MP Materials +8%, USA Rare Earth +9%, NioCorp +3% — Serra Verde August 28 Vote Drives USAR Above $20 on Policy Bets
snippet: U.S. rare earth equities staged a sector-wide surge on August 14 with no confirmed single catalyst — MP Materials (NYSE:MP) gaining 8%, USA Rare Earth (NASDAQ:USAR) up 9% to near $20.20, and NioCorp Developments (NASDAQ:NB) up 3% — as traders positioned around US tariff and industrial policy bets and a two-week event horizon: USA Rare Earth's August 28 shareholder vote on its $2.83B acquisition of Brazil's Serra Verde, the only mine outside Asia currently capable of supplying all four magnetic rare earth elements (Nd, Pr, Dy, Tb) at commercial scale. Rare earth equities in 2026 have decoupled from physical commodity prices and now trade primarily on US industrial policy signals — with federal support extending from mining into separation, refining, and magnet manufacturing — making the Serra Verde vote a referendum on whether a single company can establish Western hemisphere REE self-sufficiency from mine to magnet before China's heavy rare earth export restrictions fully propagate.

headline: DISCOVERY MINING (TSX: DSV) Q2 RECORD: $319M REVENUE DOUBLES YEAR-OVER-YEAR — 67,309 oz Gold; Kidd Operations Add Instant Production; EBITDA $170M
snippet: Discovery Mining Corp. (TSX: DSV) reported August 13 record Q2 2026 revenue of $319.1 million — more than double Q2 2025 and 12% above Q1 2026 — on gold production of 67,309 ounces (up 33% year-over-year) and adjusted net earnings of $92.3 million ($0.11/share), with EBITDA of $170 million, as the newly acquired Kidd Operations contributed its first full month of production following the June 1, 2026 closing. With 23 exploration drill rigs running across Dome, TVZ, Owl Creek, and Pamour — and resource estimates for Dome and TVZ targeted for late 2026 — Discovery is simultaneously executing production growth via acquisition, high-grade underground optimization, and aggressive near-mine exploration, all funded by Q2 cash flow that has never been larger in the company's history.

headline: ARIZONA GOLD & SILVER HITS 21.79m AT 4.10 g/t AU IN PERRY ZONE — 73m BROADER HALO AT 1.69 g/t; 16 NEW BLM PADS OPEN DEEP SYSTEM
source_name: Proactive Investors / Arizona Gold & Silver Inc. (TSX-V: AZS)
snippet: Arizona Gold & Silver Inc. (TSX-V: AZS) reported August 13 that hole PC26-169 at its Philadelphia Project in southeastern Arizona returned 21.79 metres at 4.10 g/t gold and 5.8 g/t silver within a broader 73.46-metre interval at 1.69 g/t gold — extending the Perry Zone approximately 150 metres vertically above previously reported high-grade intersections — while a newly received expanded BLM permit opens 16 additional drill pads for systematic deep testing of the Perry Zone and multiple high-priority targets. The 150-metre vertical extension of the Perry Zone above the known high-grade core is the structural finding of note: it adds a shallow, likely oxidized component to a system previously defined primarily by its deeper core, with direct implications for the capital intensity and metallurgical profile of any future mine plan in Arizona's permitting-supportive jurisdiction.

headline: SILVER PONY (CSE: PONY) GRABS 103 g/t AU FROM BC HISTORIC WORKINGS — 1,012m DRILLED; RILL NOW TARGETING UNCHARTED REVELSTOKE TREND
source_name: StockTitan / Silver Pony Resources Corp. (CSE: PONY)
snippet: Silver Pony Resources Corp. (CSE: PONY) reported August 13 that two grab samples collected from historic workings at the Ophir-Lade target on its British Columbia Silver Pony Project returned 103.0 g/t gold and 40.0 g/t gold, while four drill holes totalling 1,012.87 metres completed the first-pass test of the Black Warrior and Old Gold target areas — core assay results pending — with the drill now mobilizing to the Revelstoke Trend, an area with documented historic surface mineralization but no prior drilling of any kind. The Revelstoke Trend represents the highest-option phase of Silver Pony's 2026 program: the Black Warrior first pass is now data-gathering mode awaiting assays, while the virgin test of Revelstoke creates a genuine discovery-hole scenario where grades at surface in a historically productive mining region justify the technical speculation.

headline: GETTY COPPER (TSX-V: GTC) DRILLS 194m OF 0.62% CU FROM 27m — 60m BEYOND HISTORICAL FOOTPRINT; FALL PROGRAM NEXT, HIGHLAND VALLEY ADJACENT
source_name: The Globe and Mail / Getty Copper Inc. (TSX-V: GTC)
snippet: Getty Copper Inc. (TSX-V: GTC) released results from its 10,807-metre 2026 spring program at the Getty North porphyry copper deposit near Logan Lake, BC — with hole GN26-11 returning 194 metres at 0.62% copper from 27 metres depth, and expansion drilling extending mineralization 60 metres beyond all historical holes across three cross-sections — completing the spring program under budget, with a fall drill program planned for October. The district context is the valuation anchor: Getty North sits directly adjacent to Teck's Highland Valley Copper Mine, Canada's largest copper producer, and demonstrating that shallow, near-surface copper mineralization extends 60 metres beyond what prior exploration defined means the historical resource boundary was truncated — at $6.59/lb copper with LME inventory squeezing toward critical levels, that delta in resource geometry reprices both royalty economics and acquisition optionality.

headline: USA RARE EARTH'S $2.83B SERRA VERDE DEAL HEADS TO AUGUST 28 VOTE — Only Mine Outside Asia Supplying All Four Magnetic REEs; USAR Up 9% Today
snippet: USA Rare Earth's (NASDAQ: USAR) August 28 special meeting shareholder vote on its $2.83B acquisition of Brazil's Serra Verde Group — operator of the Pela Ema mine, the only operation outside Asia currently producing all four magnetic rare earth elements (neodymium, praseodymium, dysprosium, and terbium) at commercial scale — is the catalyst behind today's 9% USAR surge to approximately $20.20 as investors position ahead of the vote. The deal structure: $300M cash plus 126.8M shares, with Serra Verde securityholders taking 34.1% of the combined company, which would carry roughly $1.5B in cash alongside US magnet manufacturing at Stillwater, Oklahoma. If approved, the combined entity becomes the only Western-hemisphere company with producing Brazilian mine output of all four magnetic REEs plus domestic US magnet capacity — a vertical integration that no Chinese export restriction on heavy rare earths could disrupt at the processing stage.

headline: SILVER ABOVE $65 ON FOURTH SOFT MACRO PRINT — Fed Hike Odds Slide to 30.6%; $70 Target in Focus as $64 Support Holds Firm
snippet: Silver traded above $65 per troy ounce on August 14, 2026 — holding the $64 breakout level as a structural support after testing it intraday — following four consecutive weeks of below-consensus US macroeconomic data (payrolls, CPI, PPI, retail sales) that collectively reduced September Federal Reserve rate-hike probability to 30.6%, down from 50% a month ago. Technical analysts identify $70 as the next meaningful resistance level on a continuation of the current move, with the silver market defending the $64 floor aggressively on any intraday dip. For silver mining investors: the combination of declining rate-hike probability, persistent industrial demand from solar panels and EV batteries, and silver's existing 69% year-over-year gain not yet fully reflected in silver miner equity multiples — which still trade at 8–12x forward earnings versus 20–30x at prior cycle peaks — characterises the current setup as unfinished repricing rather than peak.
